description: Implementation of LoadBalancerDecoder class for handling load balancer configurations and server ID extraction in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: LoadBalancerDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding load balancer configurations and extracting server IDs from connection IDs.

methods.name: AddConfig
methods.description: Adds a new load balancer configuration if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes a load balancer configuration by ID, with bounds checking.

methods.name: GetServerId
methods.description: Extracts the server ID from a connection ID based on the current configuration.

methods.name: GetConfigId
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration ID from a connection ID or its first byte.
